resources.string: Review fetch engine

Chosen automatically from the book source declaration or the page protocol. Data endpoints currently support idea_comment paragraph reviews and nested replies; chapter and book reviews use pages. In auto mode a failing data endpoint falls back to a page snapshot; forcing the data endpoint when the review type is unsupported falls back the same way and is logged.

How many consecutive stable rounds end a traditional page; data endpoints finish on an explicit completion state.
Global concurrency for resource requests, including avatars, comment images, stylesheets and fonts; no per-page budget any more.
Reuse a resource by exact URL and image-processing requirement; when off it is downloaded again. Failures never count as cache hits.
Resource rewriting, image compression, HTML serialization and snapshot commits; network waits do not use this budget.
Total time to load and expand a traditional page; 0 means no timeout. A failing page is reported directly instead of switching engines.
Total time for one data request, including reading the body; 0 means no timeout.
Total time for one resource request, including the file transfer; 0 means no timeout.
Extra retries after the first failure of a data or resource HTTP request; 0 means no retry. Every failure and retry is recorded; cancellations are not retried.
Base wait between retries; 0 means no deliberate wait.
